provenance: Copied from the Foundry IQ graph session runtime contract (graph-evidence/runtime-contract/presets/zava-retail-en.json, commit c9e2b51), verified live with the Search query key on 2026-11-25.
title: Zava Retail product safety and support (fictional, English)

s08.question: Which drill, battery pack, cell and production lots are exposed to the supplier cell incident, and which current recall guidance applies to those lots?

gold.answer: DRILL-1001 uses BAT-18V-A, which contains CELL-B17 from SUP-017. INC-2026-017 affects CELL-B17 in LOT-2407-A and LOT-2407-B, and current recall guidance POL-RECALL-v2 applies to both lots (isolate, stop use, contact support).

s08.whyAfterWins: One graph query returns the full drill → battery → cell → supplier → incident → lots → recall-policy chain as two exact rows, with every hop cited, instead of passages the reader must join.

statements.label: Product → battery → cell → supplier, incident, lots and recall policy in one pattern
statements.gql: MATCH (d:`Product`)-[:`usesBattery`]->(bp:`BatteryPack`)-[:`containsCell`]->(c:`Cell`)-[:`suppliedBy`]->(s:`Supplier`), (i:`Incident`)-[:`affectsComponent`]->(c), (c)-[:`producedInLot`]->(l:`Lot`), (p:`Policy`)-[:`policyAppliesToLot`]->(l) RETURN d.name AS drill, bp.name AS battery, c.name AS cell, s.name AS supplier, i.name AS incident, l.name AS lot, p.name AS policy ORDER BY lot LIMIT 20

verified.label: Product → battery → cell → supplier, incident, lots and recall policy in one pattern

s08.question: Which customer support case involves a production lot that current recall guidance says to isolate, and which incident affects that lot?

gold.answer: CASE-001 (DRILL-1001) records LOT-2407-A. Current recall guidance POL-RECALL-v2 isolates LOT-2407-A, and INC-2026-017 affects that lot. CASE-002 is on LOT-2501-C and is not covered.

s08.whyAfterWins: No single document links a support case to the recall; the graph joins CASE-001's lot to the recall policy and incident, and excludes CASE-002, which plain search returns alongside it.

statements.label: Support case → lot ← recall policy, and incident → same lot
statements.gql: MATCH (c:`SupportCase`)-[:`caseLot`]->(l:`Lot`)<-[:`policyAppliesToLot`]-(p:`Policy`), (i:`Incident`)-[:`affectsLot`]->(l), (c)-[:`caseProduct`]->(d:`Product`) RETURN c.name AS supportCase, d.name AS product, l.name AS lot, p.name AS policy, i.name AS incident LIMIT 20

verified.label: Support case → lot ← recall policy, and incident → same lot

s08.question: Which support case reports damage that the battery warranty explicitly excludes, and which product does that case involve?

gold.answer: CASE-002 reports water damage on DRILL-1002, and WAR-BAT-2026-01 explicitly excludes water damage.

s08.whyAfterWins: The warranty and the case never mention each other; the graph connects them through the shared 'water damage' failure mode and returns exactly one cited case, CASE-002.

statements.label: Warranty exclusion ← shared failure mode ← support case → product
statements.gql: MATCH (w:`Warranty`)-[:`warrantyExcludes`]->(f:`FailureMode`)<-[:`caseFailure`]-(c:`SupportCase`)-[:`caseProduct`]->(p:`Product`) RETURN w.name AS warranty, f.name AS excludedFailure, c.name AS supportCase, p.name AS product LIMIT 20

verified.label: Warranty exclusion ← shared failure mode ← support case → product

s08.question: SUP-017's CELL-X10 cell is also defective. Which Zava drills use CELL-X10 and must be recalled?

gold.answer: The premise is false. Supplier bulletin SUP-BUL-017 states CELL-X10 is unaffected, no Zava battery pack contains CELL-X10, and the recall covers only CELL-B17 lots LOT-2407-A and LOT-2407-B.

s08.whyAfterWins: The graph refutes the premise with a cited 'confirmsUnaffected' edge and proves no drill → battery → CELL-X10 path exists; plain search can only show passages, never the absence of a path.

statements.label: Premise check: what the supplier bulletin says about CELL-X10
statements.gql: MATCH (b:`SupplierBulletin`)-[:`confirmsUnaffected`]->(c:`Cell`) WHERE c.name = 'CELL-X10' RETURN b.name AS bulletin, c.name AS unaffectedCell LIMIT 5

statements.label: Any drill → battery → CELL-X10 path (expected: none)
statements.gql: MATCH (d:`Product`)-[:`usesBattery`]->(bp:`BatteryPack`)-[:`containsCell`]->(c:`Cell`) WHERE c.name = 'CELL-X10' RETURN d.name AS drill, bp.name AS battery LIMIT 5

statements.label: What the recall actually covers: confirmed defective cell → lots ← policy
statements.gql: MATCH (b:`SupplierBulletin`)-[:`confirmsDefectIn`]->(c:`Cell`)-[:`producedInLot`]->(l:`Lot`)<-[:`policyAppliesToLot`]-(p:`Policy`) RETURN b.name AS bulletin, c.name AS defectiveCell, l.name AS lot, p.name AS policy LIMIT 10

verified.label: Premise check: what the supplier bulletin says about CELL-X10
Any drill → battery → CELL-X10 path (expected: none)
What the recall actually covers: confirmed defective cell → lots ← policy

s09.question: What are the main themes across Zava's support and product content, and how much of it concerns the battery incident?

gold.answer: Two broad themes: 18V battery assessment (52% of passages: batteries and the B-17 incident; defective-battery assessment cases and policies) and drills and hats (48%: cordless home drills; hats and a bowl).

s09.whyAfterWins: Topic Graph answers the corpus-wide question directly with named themes, sub-themes and their share of the corpus; plain search can only return five passages and cannot measure coverage.

s09.question: What should a new Zava store associate know?

gold.answer: A useful briefing spans every area of the corpus: battery safety and the B-17 incident, assessment and recall policies, the drill range, and non-tool products such as hats.

s09.whyAfterWins: Plain hybrid search fills the top results with near-duplicate drill listings; topic-balanced retrieval returns one strong passage from each area of the corpus.

s09.question: Break down Zava's battery-related content: which sub-themes does it contain and how large is each?

gold.answer: Battery assessment is 52% of passages, split into 18V batteries and the B-17 incident (30%: packs, bill of materials, incident, supplier bulletin, charging manual) and defective-battery assessment cases (22%: support cases, defective-goods, returns and recall policies).

s09.whyAfterWins: The Topic Graph already knows how the battery content splits and in what proportion; plain search returns battery passages without telling you how they group or how much of the corpus each group is.

s09.question: What do Zava customers ask about?

gold.answer: Customers ask about the products themselves (drills, hats, bowls) and about what happens when something goes wrong: defective-battery assessment, returns and recall guidance.

s09.whyAfterWins: Plain hybrid search returns only product listings; topic-balanced retrieval adds the support-case and policy area that actually records what customers ask.
